summary: Backend-only v20 tests for blacklist demo-lock bypass + POST alternative + plan/features endpoint. Created /app/backend/tests/test_v20_blacklist_planfeatures.py with 12 tests. All 12 PASS. All P0 items verified: (1) POST /api/blacklist/check returns 200 with results[] + providers_checked (no 423). (2) GET /api/blacklist/requests returns 200 array. (3) POST /api/blacklist/requests/{id}/update returns 404 for nonexistent id (route exists, not demo-locked). (4) PUT /api/blacklist/requests/{id} still returns 404 (also exempted from demo lock). (5) POST /api/blacklist/delist returns 200. (6) GET /api/plan/features defaults to plan='starter' with all 10 required feature keys; with license_key=MS-A1B3833C1DD6441FBCF19F26 returns plan='pro' with pro-tier flags true. (7) Regressions passing: plugin/status (mode=seller), license/violations, maintenance/cleanup, licenses list + toggle-active (round trip) + delete-probe(404). Uncovered a genuine backend bug in licenses update path — see backend_issues below.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error — AttributeError: 'LicenseIn' object has no attribute 'license_key'. server.py:2943 `payload.license_key` and 2944 `payload.panel_domains` are referenced but LicenseIn (server.py:2894) does not define these fields. Every license edit from the master UI will 500. Repro: POST /api/licenses/aa2bb3bb-387e-4819-9210-42d35a2ad415/update with a valid LicenseIn body → 500. Fix: either (a) add license_key + panel_domains to LicenseIn (making them Optional), or (b) read the existing license doc and use its license_key/panel_domains inside licenses_update() instead of payload.*. This bug is unrelated to the v20 changes under review, but blocks the requested regression.

rca of the issue: P0 blacklist 423 issue root cause: demo_write_guard middleware (server.py:4520) blocked all mutating /api/* requests in seller-mode when no master key was provided. Fix in this iteration added '/api/blacklist/' + '/api/plan/features' to _DEMO_ALLOW_PREFIXES (line 4492-4517). Apache PUT-block issue mitigated by adding POST /blacklist/requests/{id}/update as a functional alias (server.py:3481). Both fixes verified. Separately discovered: licenses_update() references non-existent payload attributes (server.py:2943) → 500 on every update — this is a pre-existing bug not caused by v20 changes but must be fixed for master UI regression.
